summary: Implemented Phases 1-5 of the multi-account (Gmail + Logos/Protonmail Bridge) revision to .claude/extensions/email/. Phase 1 added the --account <gmail|logos> / --logos selector to commands/email.md (parsed before the --sync/cleanup route split so it applies uniformly), threaded account into both delegation paths, documented per-account --archive semantics, added an unknown-account error and an actionable precondition gate for account=logos. Phase 2 (load-bearing) made skill-email-cleanup's Stage 0 BASE_QUERY account-aware via a 2x2 account x scope table (folder:Gmail/folder:Gmail/.All_Mail vs folder:Logos/folder:Logos/.Archive - folder: tokens only, zero tag:<account> usage, zero fallthrough), passed --account to every wrapper call (census, classify incl. --all sweep/count-probes/residuals, both execute binaries) using one Stage-0-resolved value, and implemented per-account pilot-gate scoping (account-keyed archive-pilot-ack.json). Phase 3 defaulted the mbsync channel from the account (gmail->gmail, logos->logos) in skill-email-sync, preserving the never-mbsync--a invariant verbatim. Phase 4 documented the account dimension in EXTENSION.md (command table, safety invariants, gated posture, mail-guard.sh no-change rationale) and added logos/proton/protonmail keywords to manifest.json. Phase 5 verified: zero tag:<account> occurrences, zero non-gmail-path folder:Gmail fallthrough, bare /email parses identically to pre-change (account=gmail default), hooks/mail-guard.sh diff is empty across all phase commits, and check-extension-docs.sh's [email] section passes. One deviation: EXTENSION.md-to-CLAUDE.md merge propagation could not be observed end-to-end because the email extension is not currently in this repo's .claude/extensions.json loaded set (pre-existing, unrelated to this task) - the merge mechanism/config were verified correct instead. Phase 6 (live /email --logos end-to-end verification + wrapper-contracts.md refresh) remains intentionally [BLOCKED] pending .dotfiles task 79 landing, exactly as scoped by the plan's approach (b).
